title: Function-valued property bindings keep recomputing after their element is removed
expected_behavior: After the price badge is closed (removed from the page), further price ticks must not recompute its title: "Badge title computations" must stop increasing. Property bindings created from functions must be released when their element is removed, while explicit van.derive states keep working.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: Rendering an SVG link fails after an HTML link with href exists
expected_behavior: Clicking "Render SVG icon link" must render the SVG <a> element with href="#top" and show the success status, even though an HTML <a href> link was created earlier on the page. HTML links, inputs and other elements must keep working.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: vanX.compact export loses each Point object's own format
expected_behavior: After deleting a point, "Export points (vanX.compact)" must output each remaining Point in its own toJSON format, e.g. ["1,2","3,4"], with holes removed; plain objects and arrays must compact as before.

title: A function stored in a VanX reactive object cannot be called
expected_behavior: The greeting card must call the function stored in the reactive field and show "Hi Ada!"; after "Use formal greeting" replaces the function, it must show "Good evening, Ms. Lovelace." Function-typed fields must stay callable.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: Reactive array length does not update after pop
expected_behavior: The release checklist shows "Tasks left: 3". Each click on "Finish last task" pops one task, so the counter must read 2, then 1, then 0. The length of a reactive array must propagate to derived states and the DOM after pop, push and index writes.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: Reading length or array methods on a reactive object throws
expected_behavior: The cart must show "Items: 2 (apple, pear)" and, after "Add plum", "Items: 3 (apple, pear, plum)" with no error. Non-state properties of reactive objects (array length, push, map, join) must be readable through the reactive proxy.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: vanX.raw breaks on reactive arrays and class instances
expected_behavior: The profile snapshot reads values through vanX.raw and must show "Name: Ada Lovelace", "Scores recorded: 3" and "Scores: 90%, 85%, 77%". vanX.raw must work for reactive arrays (length, map) and class instances (methods), while values read through vanX.raw do not subscribe to later changes.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: Sorting a VanX task list duplicates one task and loses another
expected_behavior: Clicking "Sort A to Z" (vanX.replace with the sorted array) must show each task exactly once in alphabetical order: Add docs, Fix login bug, Write release notes. Replacements that reuse existing objects must keep each object's identity and data.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: vanX.replace with a shorter array leaves a stale length
expected_behavior: After "Keep top 2" the playlist must show "Songs: 2" and "Saved as: ["Blue","Gold"]". After vanX.replace on a reactive array, the array length and JSON must match the new array, including when it shrinks or becomes empty.

title: VanX list keeps stale rows after the array is shortened
expected_behavior: After the shopping list array is shortened (for example "Keep first 2" sets items.length = 2, or "Clear list" sets it to 0), the rendered list must show exactly the remaining items, keep the surviving rows, and remove the dropped rows from the page.
